Keep private and parked dispositions unchanged. Keep rights-related outreach unsent pending human-counsel review.

Do not dispatch or requeue new work this cycle. Continue existing repair-or-close and measurement containment, and require dated ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, security, attribution, and measurement evidence before reconsidering any candidate.
